title: A research loop: plan, research, analyse, build, review, decide

brief.goal: The question the loop answers from public evidence
brief.bar: What must hold before a person would sign it

steps.name: Partner plans
steps.purpose: Keeps the issue tree and picks the round's work

steps.name: Researchers
steps.purpose: One angle each, in parallel; send one step_finished per angle with a label

steps.name: Analysts
steps.purpose: Derive numbers from the evidence with scripts

steps.name: Builder
steps.purpose: Writes the deliverable when the planner says so

steps.name: Partner decides
steps.purpose: Stop, or the brief for the next round

pace: stops after round 1 until the storyline is approved
